@@ -365,3 +365,26 @@
   crate: "sparq-engine"
   features: "spatial-exact-pushdown"
   test: true
+
+# [FABLE-5] sq-7d3dj.11: the `expr-program` opt-in FLAT compiled scalar-expression programs
+# for FILTER/BIND. The whole lowering (`exec::expr_program`, the `RowEval` program arm, the
+# `expr_program_testing` toggle in lib.rs) is `#[cfg(feature = "expr-program")]`, so the
+# default build — and ci.yml's `--workspace --all-targets` archive, which passes NO
+# `--features` — compiles it EMPTY. Its acceptance suite
+# `tests/differentials/expr_program_differential.rs` compiles in BOTH states, but WITHOUT this
+# leg its load-bearing half never runs: with the feature off both legs of `tree_vs_program`
+# are the same tree evaluator, so the ON==OFF row-identity differential (over SPARQL 3VL
+# short-circuiting, `!error`, `IF`/`COALESCE` over a type error, `IN` with an erroring member,
+# `sameTerm` vs `=`, BIND/STR term-identity passthrough, EXISTS re-entry inside a lowered
+# spine, and the rayon path) is vacuous, and the FIRED anti-vacuity counter assertion
+# (`expr_program_testing::lowered() > 0` on the program leg, `== 0` on the tree leg) is
+# `#[cfg]`-inert. This leg is where the flat evaluator is actually exercised. No new dep
+# (`expr-program = []`, no `unsafe`); with the feature off the FILTER/BIND path is the
+# verbatim tree evaluator and the scratch stack is a zero-sized placeholder, but the call-site
+# edits in `apply_filter_scalar`/`extend_bindings` are always-compiled, so the feature-OFF
+# wasm bundle MOVES BYTES vs base (behaviour-identical — declare it under
+# bench/feature-off-declarations/).
+- name: "sparq-engine (expr-program)"
+  crate: "sparq-engine"
+  features: "expr-program"
+  test: true

@@ -373,6 +373,36 @@ paths = []
 # is byte-identical. No new dependencies, no `unsafe`.
 id-filter-fastpath = []
 
+# [FABLE-5] (sq-7d3dj.11) COMPILED SCALAR-EXPRESSION PROGRAMS for FILTER/BIND. sq-7d3dj.4
+# pre-resolves every `Variable` in a FILTER/BIND expression to a column index once per
+# operator, but the result is still a `Box`-linked TREE that `eval_compiled` re-walks
+# RECURSIVELY for every row. This feature lowers that tree, once per operator, into a FLAT
+# postfix program — a `Vec<Op>` over the same resolved column indices plus constants built
+# once — evaluated per row by a straight loop over a scratch value stack the row loop (and
+# each rayon worker) reuses. It targets the STRING / LOGICAL / FUNCTION / EXISTS filter path
+# that the M4 numeric vectorisation (sq-pntvh) does not cover; there is no overlap.
+# CORRECTNESS SURFACE — the reason this is opt-in. SPARQL's three-valued logic, type-error
+# propagation and term identity must be preserved EXACTLY, so the lowering is deliberately
+# partial and every op reuses the SAME helpers as the tree arm it replaces:
+#   * lowered: `Var`/`BOUND`/constants, `!`, `&&`, `||`, `IF`, `COALESCE`, `IN`, `sameTerm`,
+#     `+ - * /`, unary sign, and function-call ARGUMENT evaluation — same operand order, same
+#     short-circuiting, same `ebv3`/`and3`/`or3`/`values_equal`/`Num::binop`.
+#   * NOT lowered (a single `Op::Tree` leaf delegating to the unchanged `eval_compiled`):
+#     `=`, the four order comparisons and `EXISTS`. `cmp_compiled`/`equal_compiled` dispatch
+#     on the SHAPE of their operand TREES (`compiled_expr_has_arith` gates the exact-decimal
+#     path; the numeric / exact-lexical / temporal fast paths each re-walk the operand), so
+#     lowering their operands would change which path a comparison takes — i.e. change results.
+#   * function BODIES stay `eval_function_inner` driven by the same LAZY per-index closure, so
+#     an argument is evaluated exactly when, and as often as, it is today.
+# Pinned by `tests/differentials/expr_program_differential.rs`, which runs BOTH evaluators in
+# ONE binary via the `expr_program_testing` runtime toggle (an ON==OFF row-identity
+# differential over 3VL / type-error / term-identity / short-circuit / EXISTS shapes, plus
+# spec-pinned expectations and a FIRED anti-vacuity counter), and by the full W3C conformance
+# suite under the feature. OPT-IN and OFF by default: when off, zero of this code compiles,
+# the scratch stack is a zero-sized placeholder and the FILTER/BIND path is the verbatim
+# tree evaluator. No new dependencies, no `unsafe`.
+expr-program = []
+
 # [FABLE-5] (sq-7d3dj.30.21) LAZY STRING-LITERAL COLLATION KEY for the top-k ORDER BY
 # selection path (`exec::order_bindings`). Profiling SP2Bench q11
 # (`ORDER BY ?ee LIMIT 10 OFFSET 50` over 17663 `rdfs:seeAlso` objects — which are

@@ -101,7 +101,7 @@ let json = sparq_engine::query_json(&g, "SELECT (COUNT(*) AS ?n) WHERE { ?s ?p ?
   for acyclic BGPs (cost-gated; cyclic keep LFTJ); `cluster-materialize` (SP2Bench q07) evaluates an unbound-predicate container-membership pattern together with its small bound-predicate anchor STANDALONE and natural-joins it to the rest, instead of bind-joining the wide relation per driver binding. Pure join-order; result-identical to off (proven differentially); off, no new deps.
 - **Algebra rewrite pass** *(opt-in `algebra-rewrite` feature, OFF by default in this library; the shipped `sparq-cli`/`sparq-server` binaries and the conformance/differential harnesses light it by default — sq-7d3dj.30.13)* — `PreparedQuery::parse` folds a `FILTER(?v = <iri>)` IRI constant into the group's triple patterns (an indexed constant-seeded scan, not a post-join filter) and rewrites `OPTIONAL … FILTER(!bound(?v))` to an anti-join (`Minus`); IRI-only (never a literal — the `sq-lr2ii` avoidance contract), bag-result-equivalent, off byte-identical, no new deps. The `antijoin-static-decline` feature (OFF by default) makes the correlated-anti-join recogniser decline via a static left/right variable-set pre-check BEFORE evaluating its mandatory left side, so a bare-`!bound` OPTIONAL (SP2Bench q07's nested levels) is not re-evaluated by the cold fallback; pure evaluation-ordering, bag-result-equivalent.
 - **Equality-FILTER value join** *(opt-in `value-join` feature, OFF by default)* — pattern components glued only by a `FILTER(?a = ?b)` equality join on a per-term-class **value** key (SPARQL `=` is value equality, not term identity) instead of cross-product-then-filter, with the original FILTER re-applied as the exact recheck (the `sq-lr2ii` high-precision-decimal class stays exact) and temporals/triple terms paired by the exact evaluator; anything not provably eligible declines to the verbatim plan. Result-identical (kill-switch differentials + an independent oracle); off, zero code compiles, no new deps.
-- **Vector-at-a-time columnar dispatch** *(opt-in `vectorized` feature, OFF by default)* — FILTER and aggregate operators use a columnar path for ≥ 256-row batches; the hybrid tri-mask delegates tie/unknown lanes to the scalar path (byte-identical). I5 probe counters (`reset_stats`/`stats_snapshot`/`VecStats`) are test-facing only. Off, zero code compiles, no new deps.
+- **Vector-at-a-time columnar dispatch** *(opt-in `vectorized` feature, OFF by default)* — FILTER and aggregate operators use a columnar path for ≥ 256-row batches; the hybrid tri-mask delegates tie/unknown lanes to the scalar path (byte-identical). I5 probe counters (`reset_stats`/`stats_snapshot`/`VecStats`) are test-facing only. Off, zero code compiles, no new deps. **Compiled scalar-expression programs** *(opt-in `expr-program` feature, OFF by default)* — a FILTER/BIND expression, already column-resolved, is lowered ONCE per operator into a flat postfix program (a `Vec` of ops over resolved column indices plus constants built once) and evaluated per row by a straight loop over a scratch value stack that the row loop — and each rayon worker — reuses, instead of recursively re-walking a `Box`-linked tree for every row. It targets the string / logical / function / `EXISTS` filter path the columnar numeric path does not cover. The lowering is deliberately partial: the order comparisons and `=` stay in tree form (their exact-decimal / numeric / temporal fast paths dispatch on the operand TREE, so lowering their operands would change which path a comparison takes), and function bodies keep the same lazy per-argument closure. Result-identical — SPARQL three-valued logic, type-error propagation and term identity are preserved op-for-op, pinned by an ON==OFF row-identity differential that runs both evaluators in ONE binary with a fired anti-vacuity counter; off, zero code compiles, no new deps.
 - **Id-level term-identity FILTER fast path** *(opt-in `id-filter-fastpath` feature, OFF by default)* — a compiled `=`/`!=` over operands a static analysis proves non-literal (subject/predicate-only variables, constant IRIs, and — via a snapshot-aware predicate-range check — an object of a constant predicate whose object column has NO literals in the current store snapshot, the SP2Bench `dc:creator`/q08/q12b shape) is decided by dictionary-id (in)equality, and equal ids of ANY kind short-circuit `=` true (canonicalising dict → sameTerm), skipping the per-row term materialisation. The predicate-range verdict is re-checked against the LIVE graph every evaluation, so an UPDATE inserting a literal object simply declines the next query (never cross-snapshot). Unequal-id literals (numeric-promotion, the `sq-lr2ii` class) and possible type-errors fall through to the exact path. Result-identical (differential vs the exact oracle); off, no new deps.
 - **Characteristic-set anchor-incidence prune** *(opt-in `cs-anchor-incidence` feature, OFF by default)* — the DISTINCT predicate-projection semijoin (`SELECT DISTINCT ?p WHERE { anchor UNION probe }`, SP2Bench q09) precomputes, per anchor join position, the SET of predicates that relate SOME anchor member, so a candidate predicate absent from that set is pruned by an O(1) membership test instead of a large no-hit clipped block scan. Result-identical (the set only prunes provably-empty existence checks; differential vs the exact scan); conservatively declines on a graph with a pending-update overlay; off, zero code compiles, no new deps.
 - **Lazy top-k string sort key** *(opt-in `topk-lazy-strkey` feature, OFF by default)* — an `ORDER BY` on a plain `xsd:string` column with a `LIMIT` builds a zero-allocation id-carrying sort key (compared via the literal's zero-copy value bytes) instead of reconstructing + re-allocating the literal value per input row, so a top-k over a large scan pays no key allocation for the rows it discards. Byte-identical output (a full-output differential + W3C ORDER BY conformance); off, zero code compiles, no new deps.
